column2: ----Operation Sealion----
column3: ----海狮行动(Operation Sealion)----

column2: By Pablo Schlegel and Santiago Fuertes
column3: 作者：Pablo Schlegel 与 Santiago Fuertes

column2: -Historical Background-
column3: -历史背景-

column2: June, 1940, the beaches of Dunkerke have been completely evacuated by the Allies, Germany has not enemies on the Continental soil of Europe at this time, which is almost conquered by the Axis forces, however, in the other side of the English Channel, the British are preparing the defence of their homeland, after refusing the German demands of peace...
column3: 1940 年 6 月，盟军已完全撤出敦刻尔克(Dunkerke)的海滩，此时德国在欧洲大陆土地上已没有敌人，欧洲大陆几乎被轴心国军队征服，然而在英吉利海峡的另一边，英国人在拒绝德国的和平要求后，正在准备本土的防御……

column2: In order to finish with the war in the West, the German High Command started to plan an invasion over the British Islands, firstly called ''Lion'' by Alfred Jodl, and later renamed as ''Unternehmen SeeLöwe'', mostly known as Operation Sealion, the plan considered the English Channel as a big river.
column3: 为了结束西线的战争，德国最高统帅部开始筹划入侵不列颠群岛，该计划最初被 Alfred Jodl 称为「Lion」，后来改名为「Unternehmen SeeLöwe」，通常称为海狮行动，计划把英吉利海峡当作一条大河。

column2: General, in this campaign you will confront that you were supposed to confront a Nazi General in the supposed case that the plan was executed as planned dated on September 24th of 1940, day in which all units that are stationed in France waiting to embark to the England's South Coast.
column3: 将军，在这场战役中，您将面对的是：假如计划按原定方案于 1940 年 9 月 24 日执行，您本该面对的纳粹将军所面对的局面，那一天所有驻扎在法国等待登船前往英格兰南海岸的单位。

column2: The plan was never executed due to disagreement between the OKH, OKL and the OKW, however, now in PG2 the naval transports are departing from Cherbourg, Le Havre, and Calais with troops for invade Great Britain!, could you conquest Great Britain and get a success where the Spanish and Frenchs weren't succesfully in the past?, could you take Winston Churchill and the Royal Family as prisoners?, all is in your hands now!, good luck, Herr General.
column3: 由于 OKH、OKL 与 OKW 之间的分歧，该计划从未执行，不过现在在 PG2 中，海上运输船正载着部队从瑟堡(Cherbourg)、勒阿弗尔(Le Havre)和加来(Calais)出发去入侵大不列颠！您能征服大不列颠，取得当年西班牙人和法国人未能取得的成功吗？您能把 Winston Churchill 和王室俘为战俘吗？现在一切都掌握在您手中！祝您好运，将军先生。

column2: -The Plan -
column3: -计划-

column2: The plan of the invasión is based on the modified plan of Heer, considering the Channel like a big river.
column3: 入侵计划以陆军修改后的计划为基础，把海峡当作一条大河。

column2: The crossing of the first wave of troops would be made by 13 divisions in four days, with around 250.000 mens and 650 tanks, transported on barges and many different ships. The first objetives would be the ports of South England, like Dover and Portsmouth. Later, the next waves of disembarks will consist of 3 motorized divisions, 6 Panzer divisions and 17 infantry divisions. The supply areas are between Dover and Margate, with the Kriegsmarine custodying the zone.
column3: 第一波部队的渡海将在四天内由 13 个师完成，约 250.000 人和 650 辆坦克，用驳船和许多不同的船只运输。首批目标是英格兰南部的港口，如多佛(Dover)和朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)。随后，下一波登陆将由 3 个摩托化师、6 个装甲师和 17 个步兵师组成。补给区位于多佛与马盖特(Margate)之间，由德国海军看守该区域。

column2: -The campaign-
column3: -战役-

column2: Consist of 25 scenarios in 3 different paths following the German invasion plans of Great Britain. Each path has 6 or 8 scenarios until the final battle for London. After the attack over London, you will face the British in other 3 scenarios more in the Mediterranean Sea.
column3: 由 25 个场景组成，分为 3 条不同的路线，遵循德国入侵大不列颠的计划。每条路线有 6 或 8 个场景，直到最后争夺伦敦的战斗。进攻伦敦之后，您还将在其他 3 个场景中于地中海面对英军。

column2: We have designed the scenarios trying to put on them the more historical sense possible, studiying the British forces based on the Islands around the years 1939 and 1940.
column3: 我们设计这些场景时尽可能赋予其历史感，研究了 1939 年和 1940 年前后不列颠群岛上的英军。

column2: This campaign bring the player the possibility of use user made smacks too, the smacks are little video-clips, wich improves the atmosphere of the campaign, you don't need to install them to play, however you will enjoy most the campaing if you install the smacks. The installation of the smacks is the next;
column3: 本战役也让玩家可以使用用户制作的 smacks，smacks 是短小的视频片段，能提升战役的氛围，您不安装它们也能玩，但安装 smacks 会让您更享受这场战役。安装 smacks 的步骤如下；

column2: -\tDownload the Sealion Smacks from http://es.geocities.com/latingenerals/ , the smacks needed are Sealion, London 1940 and Sealion Victory.
column3: -\t从 http://es.geocities.com/latingenerals/ 下载海狮 smacks，需要的 smacks 是 Sealion、London 1940 和 Sealion Victory。

column2: -\tCopy the ''SMACK'' folder from the PG2 CD and paste it into the main PG2 folder on your hard disk.
column3: -\t从 PG2 光盘复制「SMACK」文件夹，粘贴到您硬盘上的主 PG2 文件夹中。

column2: -\tRemove the property of ''Only Read'' of all the smacks you have paste into the smack folder on your hard disk (c:\panzer2\smack), and put there the Sealion Smacks.
column3: -\t去掉您粘贴到硬盘上 smack 文件夹（c:\panzer2\smack）中的所有 smacks 的「只读」属性，然后把海狮 smacks 放进去。
